title: skills: the object `enable` capability table does not teach `aiReadable` (read-only AI exposure, `sys_*` objects only) — PR #32971's Skills-docs follow-up
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1T5HEokjRgR6vCBX8

Filing gate: ① published skill text that omits a key an in-flight PR adds, owed by PR #32971's `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line; the seat files the card and rewrites that line to this number. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reader: `domain:skills` (`skills/**`, shipped with `npx skills add`).
Blocked-by: #32971
Dedupe: `is:issue aiReadable skills enable` → 0 hits besides #32865 / #32971.
reach: named producer — the published skill an authoring agent loads, `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (the object `enable` capability table, on `origin/main`).

## What changes after #32971
`ObjectCapabilities` gains `enable.aiReadable` (optional boolean): a `sys_*` object opens read-only AI access (query, get one, aggregate, describe, list; never write) by declaring it. It is refused at parse on any object whose name does not start with `sys_`, and on the stored-metadata-body family (`STORED_METADATA_BODY_OBJECTS`) whatever its name. Reader in `@objectstack/spec/data`: `isAiReadExposed`.

## Do
Add one `aiReadable` row to the `enable` table in `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, saying it exists for platform system objects and that an app author never writes it (a parse error on an app object). Changeset `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

Related: #32865, #32971, #32442 (the server half that makes the key live).
